info.name: Retail reporting - 10 insert records
info.description: Ten insert bodies for every retail reporting endpoint. Run folders from top to bottom: batch, then shift, then orders, then the other tables. Set storeCode to a RETAIL store and set keyId plus posSecret from that store's issued POS credential. Send one request at a time. The JSON files in this folder are the same bodies. Sample machine passwords are fake placeholders.

exec: throw new Error("Set storeCode, keyId and posSecret using this retail store's issued POS credentials.");
if (!pm.request.body || pm.request.body.mode !== "raw") throw new Error("Select Body > raw > JSON.");
if (Array.isArray(JSON.parse(rawBody))) throw new Error("Send ONE object per request, not the 10-record array.");
if (secret.length !== 32) throw new Error("posSecret must be the issued Base64-encoded 32-byte POS secret.");
const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", secret, { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" }, false, ["sign"]);
const signed = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, new TextEncoder().encode(canonical)));
